d: We are seeking a proactive, organized, and detail-oriented Procurement Officer to manage purchasing activities and support the efficient sourcing of goods and services. The ideal candidate will be responsible for coordinating with suppliers, evaluating quotations, processing purchase orders, and ensuring that procurement activities meet operational requirements, quality standards, and budget expectations.
Manage daily purchasing and procurement activities in accordance with company requirements.
Identify, evaluate, and source reliable suppliers and vendors.
Request and compare quotations to obtain competitive prices and favorable terms.
Prepare, process, and monitor purchase orders and procurement documentation.
Negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, and contract terms with suppliers.
Coordinate with internal departments to understand purchasing needs and specifications.
Monitor supplier performance, product quality, and delivery timelines.
Maintain accurate records of purchases, supplier information, invoices, and contracts.
Follow up on outstanding orders and resolve supply or delivery issues.
Monitor inventory requirements and assist with stock replenishment planning.
Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies and relevant procedures.
Relevant qualifications in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
Understanding of purchasing procedures, supplier management, and procurement documentation.
Strong negotiation, communication, and coordination skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple purchasing requests and meet deadlines.
Responsible, trustworthy, and capable of working independently or within a team.
Opportunities to develop procurement and supplier management skills.
Exposure to purchasing strategies and supply chain operations.
Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
